integrity: The analytic sign-chamber count and spherical probability integral were reconstructed and independently cross-checked by an edge-angle expectation identity. There is no independent validation or historical-priority certification; inaccessible older geometric works leave residual novelty risk.
limitations: The proof concerns only central Haar-uniform sections of congruent-square right antiprisms with relative twist pi/4 and positive height. Translated sections, arbitrary twists and shapes, and section metric distributions are not covered. Finite numerical checks do not prove universal quantifiers.
title: Two-point central-section law and sharp aspect-ratio transitions for square antiprisms
